notes.title: Adventure Discovery Bundle
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Just to announce you that Yesterday Origins is also available in a special adventure Microïds games bundle named: [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3031/Adventure_Discovery_Bundle/]Adventure Discovery Bundle[/url]. 

Inside you have 6 games including the episodes 1 & 2 of the famous Syberia saga: 
- [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/46500/Syberia/]Syberia[/url] (82 Metascore)
- [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/46510/Syberia_II/]Syberia II[/url] (80 Metascore)
- [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/322970/Subject_13/]Subject 13[/url]
- [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/374900/Agatha_Christie__The_ABC_Murders/]Agatha Christie - The ABC Murders[/url] 
- [url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/92163/]The Descendant - Complete Season (Episodes 1-5)[/url]
- [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/465280/Yesterday_Origins/]Yesterday Origins[/url] (74 Metascore)
								
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/bundles/3031/evjh1vys131kcnd2/header_586x192.jpg?t=1493033013[/img]

Enjoy!

notes.title: [UPDATE] HUMAN CALCULATOR
notes.content:
Dear friends, 

A new update of the game is available. You'll be finally able to unlock all the achievements. 

What's in the update:

- "Human Calculator" achievement fixed (we hope this time all is right :D)
-  Minor bug fixes

Thanks for playing!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25308514/da36c82a48fe8cfe4ebfb5e609bcd8438a621f5b.png[/img]
